How this resource handles information about visitors.

01Browsing and local preferences02Hosting and security logs03Analytics, cookies and third-party tracking04Questions about privacy05What this notice does not claim06Continue from here
01

Browsing and local preferences

No account or sign-in is required to read the evidence. This resource stores a language preference in the visitor’s browser so that the site opens in the last language chosen, Arabic or English, on a return visit; this is local preference storage, not a user profile.

02

Hosting and security logs

This resource is hosted on DigitalOcean App Platform. Readers reach it through causewaygrp.com, CauseWay's own website, which passes each request for these pages on to it. The causewaygrp.com website therefore receives the technical details that come with every request, such as the page address, the time of the request, the IP address and the browser type; if the browser holds the cookie that the causewaygrp.com website sets, that cookie is sent to the website with each request. App Platform, including the content-delivery network it serves through, receives each request as it is passed on. Either may keep such details in logs. Which details are kept, for what purpose, for how long and by which provider has not yet been confirmed; it will be stated here once it is.

03

Analytics, cookies and third-party tracking

Core evidence browsing, on-site search and navigation do not require third-party analytics or advertising trackers. If non-essential analytics, cookies or identifiers are enabled later, they must be disclosed before activation and included in any choice or consent mechanism that applies. This resource sets no cookies; at its public address on causewaygrp.com, browsers may also send a cookie that the causewaygrp.com website sets for all its pages, and this resource does not read it.

04

Questions about privacy

Privacy questions about this resource may be sent to office@causewaygrp.com with “Yemen Financial Inclusion Evidence — Privacy” in the subject. Do not send passwords, financial credentials or unnecessary sensitive personal data.

05

What this notice does not claim

This notice does not claim that any particular hosting log, retention period, analytics service, cookie or processor exists until that has been confirmed and stated here.
